subject: Aurora Analytics — procurement security evidence & PO path
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@auroraanalytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@auroraanalytics.com
Date: Sun, 15 Sep 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora Analytics — onboarding package & next steps

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Procurement asked me to pull together the onboarding checklist so we can get Aurora live next month. Can you confirm the exact security/privacy artifacts you need from Redwood and the PO routing for our accounts payable?

From our side we can provide:
- W-9 and vendor profile (attached)
- Bank remit (we can send on request)

Can you share:
1) DPA / contract template you expect to sign (DocuSign preferred)
2) SOC 2 report or access link we can send to our security team
3) Current subprocessor list (we need to confirm there are no analytics partners that conflict with our controls)
4) PO and invoice instructions (email and any required fields)

Attachments: Aurora_W9.pdf, Aurora_vendor_profile.xlsx

Goal: lock sign-off and PO by end of next week. Let me know if you need any additional forms.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement
Aurora Analytics
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@auroraanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Sep 2029 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Analytics — onboarding package & next steps

Hi Marta — thanks, received the attachments. High-level checklist below so your security and procurement teams have a single place to track items. I copied our procurement lead (Laura) and your account rep (Jonas).

Required from Redwood (we will send these to you):
- DPA (DocuSign link below) — standard Redwood DPA for hosted inference; we can accept a short, non-substantive signature redline window.
- SOC 2 Type II report (read-only link): https://redwood-secure.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2/2028-12-report.pdf
- Current subprocessor inventory (CSV) — attached to this thread: redwood_subprocessors_v2.csv
- Vendor intake form (please complete so legal/procurement have billing details): https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/vendor-intake-form-aurora

PO / invoice routing:
- Please send official PO to procurement@redwood.ai (include our vendor ID field — we'll confirm after intake form).
- Invoices to finance-invoice@redwood.ai with PO number in the subject line. Payment terms are Net 30 by default.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Fill the intake form and attach signed W-9 (we have your W-9 but prefer the signed version).
2) Sign the DPA via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/REDWOOD-DPA-2029
3) Send PO to procurement@redwood.ai and cc laura_bennett@redwood.ai

We will review any proposed redlines, but the legal team typically asks for a brief summary of requested changes up front to speed review. If your security team has follow-ups on the SOC2, they can send questions to security-eval@redwood.ai and we will triage.

I attached the current subprocessor list for transparency. Let us know if you need an NDA or any additional attestations.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Lead — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@auroraanalytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@auroraanalytics.com>, procurement@auroraanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 16 Sep 2029 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Analytics — onboarding package & next steps

Thanks Soojin — useful checklist. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- We attached a signed W-9 and a redacted bank stub for vendor setup (Aurora_W9_signed.pdf, Aurora_bank_stub_redacted.pdf). Please confirm receipt.
- On the DPA: are you able to accept our standard SOC2-related clause that limits subprocessor transfers without prior notice? If not, can you indicate which sections of the DPA are commonly negotiated so our legal team can prioritize?
- Regarding subprocessors: the CSV you sent shows two analytics partners (SignalPlus, MetricsNow). Can you confirm whether either of those have access to raw customer content or only aggregated telemetry? Our security team will want that clarified before signing.

Tentative timeline: if we can get DPA and subprocessor confirmation by Wednesday, procurement will issue PO Thursday. Is that timeline workable?

Thanks — Sam
Senior Procurement Analyst
Aurora Analytics

Attachments: Aurora_W9_signed.pdf, Aurora_bank_stub_redacted.pdf

Hi Sam / Marta — confirmed received the signed W-9 and bank stub, thanks. A few quick answers and next steps so procurement can keep the timeline: 

1) Subprocessors: SignalPlus and MetricsNow only receive aggregated telemetry (no customer prompt/content). I've flagged this with our security team; they will provide a short attestation (1–2 lines) stating that neither partner processes raw customer content for Aurora's account. Expect that attestation within 24 hours.

2) DPA redlines: the most common negotiation points are around liability caps, data deletion timelines, and audit scope. If you can share the clauses you'd like changed, our legal team will review under an expedited window. For rapid progress, signing the DPA unredlined and then requesting a narrow amendment is our preferred flow; the DocuSign link again is: https://docusign.com/REDWOOD-DPA-2029

3) Timeline: we can target Wednesday to confirm the attestation and have the signed DPA by Thursday. Once DPA is signed and vendor intake form is complete, Laura will generate a vendor ID and procurement will accept the PO sent to procurement@redwood.ai.

4) Contacts: Laura Bennett (procurement lead) — laura_bennett@redwood.ai; Jonas Weber (account exec) — jonas_weber@redwood.ai; Legal follow-up — legal-ops@redwood.ai.

I'll add the HubSpot deal reference to the record: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345-RDW-2387 so your team can match the PO to the right opportunity. Ping me directly if anything shifts on your side.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Soojin
Senior Account Lead — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
